key_highlights: ASX shed $90b in a week on rate-rise fears and oil price surge, signalling sharp risk-off rotation
Iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
AUD smashed on growth scare, amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure (+30c/L)
Oil price spike from failed suppression threatens Qantas.AX, Sydney Air.AX margins
ANZ.AX axing 3,500 jobs signals financial sector cost-cutting cycle; grand plan still unproven
Housing correction deepens with no spring bounce; first-home buyer surge offers partial offset
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital stress across junior miners
Santos preservation deemed a national sacrifice, reshaping energy sector dynamics
Geopolitical escalation (Russia strike near Poland border) adds tail-risk premium

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting'; junior miners rushing cap raises via Canaccord; gold underperforming ('gold schmould'). PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Junior miners (ASX: small-caps) face dilution risk. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lack safe-haven bid despite geopolitical tension.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs in restructuring; rate-rise fears pressure NIM expectations. Superannuation debate (populism vs. integrity) creates policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: Cost-cutting may support near-term EPS but signals weak loan growth. CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX watch ANZ playbook. Super policy risk is a medium-term overhang on sector multiples.

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; fuel prices +30c. Santos preservation framed as national sacrifice. LNG and coal exposed to global price volatility.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from oil spike but face policy constraints. Qantas.AX, Sydney Air.AX, QGR.AX hit by fuel cost pass-through. Coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) mixed on demand signals.

sectors.trend: Woolworths.AX caught raising 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze promo, eroding consumer trust. Housing correction boosts first-home buyer activity but overall consumer confidence weak.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure and reputational risk. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPL.AX) benefit from rental demand but face occupancy headwinds. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: Prostate cancer funding redirected to McGrath Foundation; Nano-X (US) cost-cutting. AI development slowdown calls from tech execs. ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing momentum.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX stable but no catalyst. ASX tech small-caps (NEU.AX, ION.AX) volatile. AI slowdown narrative may pressure global tech but limited ASX direct exposure.

sectors.trend: No spring bounce in auction market; housing prices crashing but first-home buyers surging. Social rental build in Perth CBD signals policy-driven supply.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, VMC.AX) face yield compression risk. Construction (WBC.AX, WES.AX) mixed. Perth-focused REITs may see rental support.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears driving $90b ASX sell-off; bond yield spike pressuring equities
Iron ore structural decline hitting ASX 20 heavyweights
AUD weakness amplifying inflation and import costs
Oil spike creating stagflationary pressure on airlines and transport
Housing correction: pain for owners, opportunity for first-home buyers
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises and dilution risk
Geopolitical escalation (Russia-Poland, Indonesia) adding risk premium
Superannuation policy debate creating regulatory uncertainty
Consumer trust erosion (Woolworths pricing, business confidence)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; hedge with gold or energy hedges
Shift to short-duration bonds, quality dividend payers; avoid rate-sensitive REITs
Maintain 10-15% cash; hold gold miners as tail-risk hedge despite 'gold schmould'

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / fuel cost inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight Qantas.AX, Sydney Air.AX; overweight Santos.AX, Woodside.AX
Monitor construction and bank loan-loss provisions; avoid overexposure to property REITs
Avoid junior miners with imminent raises; favour cash-flow-positive majors

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'explosion' and failed suppression support upstream margins; Santos preservation adds policy tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Selective mining exposure via gold and specialty metals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting hurts majors, but geopolitical risk and cap-raise stress create relative value in gold (GOLD.AX) and small-cap winners (PolarX, Manuka)
Housing crash driving buyer surge; social rental build in Perth signals policy support for affordable housing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce ASX 200 mining weight; shift to quality dividend defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: $90b ASX loss on rate fears and iron ore decline; BHP/RIO/FMG face structural margin pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight airlines and transport on fuel cost spike
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil surge + 30c fuel rise + staff shortages (1 in 3 flights cancelled) compress margins
Geopolitical escalation, AUD weakness, and rate uncertainty create elevated tail risk

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. $90b weekly loss, iron ore bloodletting, AUD smash, and oil spike create a stagflationary backdrop. RBA rate-rise fears dominate. Expect continued ASX 200 weakness, particularly in materials and rate-sensitive sectors. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise within 6-12 months as first-home buyers absorb supply. Energy transition and AI infrastructure (despite slowdown calls) offer structural growth. Superannuation reform, if constructive, could unlock long-term capital flows. Iron ore oversupply may correct by H2 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (rate-rise risk)
ANZ.AX restructuring progress and EPS impact
Chinese Arctic shipping route implications for trade flows
watch_list: RBA cash rate and inflation (CPI) data
Brent crude and Australian fuel prices
ANZ.AX, CBA.AX NIM and loan growth metrics
Housing auction clearance rates and first-home buyer data
